output: Scientific Hypothesis: There is no significant relationship between income and the likelihood of maintaining the same level of savings in the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY79) dataset. The analysis found a coefficient of approximately -0.0056 for the relationship between income and the likelihood of maintaining the same level of savings, which is not statistically significant (p-value ≈ 1.99). This suggests that income does not have a significant impact on the likelihood of maintaining the same level of savings in this dataset.
